### 💡 Codex Review Here are some automated review suggestions for this pull request. **Reviewed commit:** `bef2861a9e`
ℹ️ About Codex in GitHub
[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new validation script `issue_1647_final_holdout.py` and its corresponding unit tests, along with several artifact files documenting the results of a final holdout validation run for issue #1647. The validation run scored 58/60 (96.67%), falling just short of the required 97% gate and resulting in a "HOLD" verdict. Feedback on the code changes suggests populating the `rows` array in the generated `repeated-defect-audit.v1.json` artifact with details of the counted defects instead of leaving it hardcoded as empty, which will improve the utility of the artifact for debugging.

Independent exact-head review: **changes required**

Reviewed SHA: `bef2861a9e48a8da83f9ac36c74cc8db7454246c`

Blocking findings:

1. The durable required validation command is broken. It names `frozen-run-manifest.v1.json` and `candidate-blind-truth.v1.json`, neither of which exists at this head, so the command fails with `manifest_missing_or_outside_repo_global_stop`. The checked-in filenames are `frozen-holdout-manifest.v1.json` and `independent-source-truth.v1.json`; the corrected command passes. Repair the durable baseline/request so the required command is executable.
2. The repeated-defect evidence is internally contradictory. `validation-summary.v1.json` reports `repeated_defect_count: 1` and `zero_repeated_1645_structural_defects: false`; `repeated-defect-audit.v1.json` also reports count 1 but supplies no rows. By contrast, `post-run-residual-and-defect-audit.v1.json` and `final-report.v1.md` assert zero. Reconcile the classification deterministically and regenerate dependent receipts/report text.
3. The requested `gh pr checks 1648` baseline is not green: both ESLint jobs are currently cancelled, so the command exits nonzero.

- changed-file secret-pattern scan found no credentials

No files, commits, pushes, merges, or implementation ownership changes were made by the reviewer.
